feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete original-game stage +TIME decoration and numeric glyphs a single binocular ScreenHud feature by preserving exact producer ownership across immediate game Draws, deferred SpriteNodes and reentrant queue fallback, without changing the underlying time extension gameplay.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only six original +TIME E8 call parents and their scope lifetime in src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp. Protect GOAL, timer logic, rank markers, F11, ESC, SkyGlow, world, input, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original EXE 0x9898E/0x98A36/0x98AC6 sprani and 0x989AD/0x98A10/0x98A89 numeric print CALLs enter StageExtensionEnter.

Immediate glyph emission uses ScopedExactProducerSemantic before queue, while TagAppendedNodes assigns StageExtensionTime to deferred SpriteNode siblings; consumed node propagates the token through Sumo replay.
R30 c64/XYRHW/fixed-function Draw and two-eye projection consume explicit ScreenHud rather than a previously armed world/GOAL NextDrawScope; host composition keeps existing optical model.
subcomponents: Shield and restore a previous non-+TIME pending Draw while stamping the original immediate +TIME numeric producer token, not merely post-call queue tags.
Preserve the active queue owner on reentrant exact E8 calls and keep all three decoration and all three numeric print E8 hooks scoped together with deferred tagged children.
Prove positive and destructive negative cases with deterministic header smoke/source mutation and full exact-SHA Win32 host/game/package and isolation gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Immediate +TIME number/print children use ScreenHud and StageExtensionTime, never consuming unrelated queued or pending world Draw scope.
Deferred +TIME decorations and digits keep their existing exact StageExtensionTime queue tags; SpriteQueueDepth and pending Draw are preserved on nested calls.
One material/validation SHA passes canonical DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/full-chain/package plus Domain Isolation and Source Impact when applicable; Quest3 optical test remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Historical +TIME sprite and text duplication persists while six exact E8 sources were identified and deferred queue tags added; there is no matching Quest3 optical retest for this fix.
source_trace: Three sprani original E8 producers queue decorations through StageExtensionEnter/Leave.
Three 0x989xx print E8 parents render number glyphs directly before deferred tagging applies.
ScopedExactProducerSemantic enters render_semantics.hpp, ConsumeForDraw/R30 projection and stereo host ownership; NextDrawScope and direct token were not isolated.
diagnosis.root_cause: Existing StageExtensionDirectDrawOwner.emplace(ScreenHud) used default isolatePendingDraw=false and default direct producer=None, so a previously armed scene/world Draw could steal +TIME text ownership despite correct later SpriteNode tags; unconditional CurrentScope assignment could override a reentrant queue.
alternatives_rejected: The six source E8 parents and TagAppendedNodes were already installed; duplicating parent hooks does not address direct glyph scope.
Broad ScreenOverlay2D promotion or blanket Reset would disturb GOAL, rank, F11 and other known-good visuals.
Changing game time calculation fn43FA10 cannot repair render ownership of +TIME text.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Scope and token belong only to original +TIME direct print and queued decoration siblings; no global R30 projection or SkyGlow change.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Dedicated header behavior smoke asserts direct-owner shielding/restoration and nested queue no-override; provenance verifier kills three owner and one restoration source mutations.

runtime_gate: Quest3/VDXR matching SHA stage checkpoint: simultaneous decorated +TIME and numeric glyphs single/stable in both eyes; GOAL, normal timer, 6th/6 and headset recenter unchanged. Not tested.
hold_resolution: The initial a67c5c3d DX9Ex Active policy step rejected the new source-safe RAII StageExtension direct owner. The source-aware verifier was corrected at exact SHA e55666ee. DX9Ex Active 5/5, Domain Isolation, Source Impact 3/3 and HUD Inspector 2/2 all SUCCESS on that exact SHA. HMD runtime UNTESTED.
